description: The --shard option of tests/run-all.mjs (CI runs the Hub suites of each OS and Node version in two jobs): the split rule (listed suites heaviest first to the lightest shard, ties to the lower number, then unlisted suites by name at the mean of the listed suites that exist), the filter after the split, the shard a job takes, name order inside a shard, the weights file and its checks, the usage check, and summary.shard, judged by tests/verify-test-runner.mjs (worked examples for 2 and 3 shards, coverage for 1 to 13 shards, the real suites against the committed weights).

mutations.name: TRS-tie-to-higher-shard
mutations.what: a tie between shards goes to the higher number

mutations.name: TRS-lightest-first
mutations.what: the listed suites are placed lightest first

mutations.name: TRS-unlisted-weigh-nothing
mutations.what: a suite the weights file does not list weighs nothing

mutations.name: TRS-mean-counts-stale-entries
mutations.what: the mean also counts listed suites that no longer exist

mutations.name: TRS-unlisted-placed-first
mutations.what: the unlisted suites are placed before the listed ones

patches.old:
for (const name of [...listed].sort((a, b) => weights.get(b) - weights.get(a) || byName(a, b))) place(name, weights.get(name));
  for (const name of [...unlisted].sort(byName)) place(name, mean);
patches.new:
for (const name of [...unlisted].sort(byName)) place(name, mean);
  for (const name of [...listed].sort((a, b) => weights.get(b) - weights.get(a) || byName(a, b))) place(name, weights.get(name));

mutations.name: TRS-one-pass
mutations.what: one pass over all suites by weight, the unlisted ones at the mean among the listed ones

patches.old:
for (const name of [...listed].sort((a, b) => weights.get(b) - weights.get(a) || byName(a, b))) place(name, weights.get(name));
  for (const name of [...unlisted].sort(byName)) place(name, mean);
patches.new:
const weightOf = (name) => (weights.has(name) ? weights.get(name) : mean);
  for (const name of [...names].sort((a, b) => weightOf(b) - weightOf(a) || byName(a, b))) place(name, weightOf(name));

mutations.name: TRS-filter-before-split
mutations.what: --filter is applied before the split, so the filter moves suites between shards

mutations.name: TRS-shard-in-placement-order
mutations.what: a shard runs its suites in the order they were placed, not by name

mutations.name: TRS-weights-file-ignored
mutations.what: the weights file is never read: every suite weighs the same

mutations.name: TRS-negative-seconds-accepted
mutations.what: a negative number of seconds in the weights file is accepted

mutations.name: TRS-summary-without-shard
mutations.what: the JSON summary does not record the shard
